acf.speaker_position: Intercultural trainer, IT Marketing and Partnerships professional

blocks.html: Indologist. Orientalist with a South Asia Studies diploma (Hindi language specialization) and an International Relations Master's Degree graduate. Business Trainer with a strong focus on intercultural communication with India, leading cross-cultural trainings and consulting for big corporations, IT companies, start-ups, manufacturers, international agencies, and other organizations that work on an international level. IT Marketing and Partnerships professional. Focused on getting in-depth knowledge of CTOs’ (and other tech leaders’) perspectives.
